entries.back_en: "I see...It's all right, [name].So...That's the dragon, eh?"
"On behalf of my troops...I offer my apologies for any...trouble caused you, young dragon..."
"Even if we knew not what we did, we aided him in his pursuit of power...We helped him try to kill a god...I suppose it is fitting we should suffer the god's anger..."
"Still...Argh!We cannot allow the entire world to be destroyed...For one man's ambition..."
"And that's why you tried to meet with the First Emperor?"
"You too are a god...Oh mighty god...We...We are foolish...We are mere mortals...We deserve this fate for what we tried to do..."
"Still, oh mighty god...If there be a sliver of mercy in your soul...Do not punish our children...for what we did...Let them have a future...uh!"
entries.note: 'Não punis' é gramaticalmente incorreto; deveria ser 'Não punais'.

entries.back_en: "General...I don't know how to say this well, but..."
"Ha ha ha ha!It is well the Yorae Dragon has you all as friends...Perhaps there is yet hope for us..."
"You've done well, Captain [name].I want you to take them...All of them...To the Imperial Castle...The God Emperor waits there."
entries.note: 'Quero que os levei' conjugação errada; deveria ser 'leveis'.

entries.back_en: "Don't worry about me...I'll be fine.More importantly...I'd like to hear you call me like you used to...Once more."
entries.note: 'Ficará bem' usa 3ª pessoa; deveria ser 'Ficarei bem' (eu).

entries.back_en: "My dear [name]...I wasn't able to do as much for you as I wanted...You deserved much more than this old soldier could give."
"Listen to me, [name]...If there is a tomorrow...I want you to live every day...Each moment...To the fullest...Be happy, [name]...uhh!"
entries.note: 'Ouça-me' (você) inconsistente com vós usado no resto ('vivais','Sede').

entries.back_en: "Go now.What happens next...is up to you...You, and the Yorae Dragon."
entries.note: 'custa a vós' = 'costs you'; deveria ser 'cabe a vós/depende de vós'.

entries.back_en: "Troops went inside...I just hope they can get rid of that monster that attacked..."
